narrationScript: One puppy has the bed. Another circles the cushion, keeps coming back, and finally climbs right in beside it. Suddenly, the quiet corner has become a two puppy hangout.

storyBeats.development: Another puppy circles and returns to the cushion.
storyBeats.payoff: The visitor climbs into the bed alongside the first puppy.
